# Paddle Board Overstock

> Paddle Board Overstock designs and manufactures professional-grade inflatable SUP boards and paddling accessories in its own 12,000 m2 factory in Weihai, China.

Founded in 2012 in Weihai, China, Paddle Board Overstock operates 6 production lines with 200-300 staff and an annual capacity of 15,000 units. Every unit passes a 24-48h hold at 1.25x rated pressure, and outgoing shipments achieve a 99.3% defect-free rate. Paddle Board Overstock ships to 50+ countries. 1 unit — overstock clearance, no MOQ. Since September 2026 the brand has been operated by Weihai Dongjilian Co., Ltd., with R&D and production at the Paddle Board Overstock Weihai Manufacturing Hub.

## Company

- [Products](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/products/): Catalog of inflatable SUP boards and paddling accessories
- [Factory](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/factory/): 12,000 m2 vertically integrated factory in Weihai, Weihai — 6 production lines, 15,000 units annual capacity
- [Quality Control](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/quality/): 24-48h hold at 1.25x rated pressure, 99.3% defect-free rate
- [Technology](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/technology/): Drop-stitch, welding, and hull technologies used in production
- [Safety](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/safety/): Safety equipment and safety gear
- [Engineering Team](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/engineering-team/): In-house engineering and R&D capabilities
- [About](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/about/): Company background — established 2012, operated by Weihai Dongjilian Co., Ltd. since September 2026, exports to 50+ countries
- [FAQ](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/faq/): Answers to common paddler questions
- [Contact](https://paddleboardoverstock.com/id/contact/): Contact the customer support team
